newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP legislators agree to seek extra Japan budget.
newsitem.headline: LDP legislators agree to seek extra Japan budget.

text.p: Senior executives of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), the biggest force in Japan's three-way ruling coalition, agreed on Tuesday to seek an extra budget for the current fiscal year to next March 31, a senior LDP official told reporters.
"Party executives agreed to work on the issue of a supplementary budget," the official said after a meeting of senior LDP legislators.

The executives agreed that the government may need to draft an extra budget to support the nation's economy and finance government measures taken to cope with a deadly food poisoning epidemic that swept the country this summer, he said.
